meta.title: Factorio — Admin panel
meta.description: RCON console for the headless Factorio server

dot.ok: Server reachable, {count, plural, =0 {no player} one {# player} other {# players}} online

console.title: RCON console
console.emptyWritable: Type a Factorio command (e.g. /players, /version) or use the quick actions. Text without a leading “/” is broadcast to the chat.
console.emptyReadOnly: Use the quick actions: their results appear here.

lua.title: Lua command
lua.warning: This command uses the Lua console: it permanently disables achievements for this save.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This address does not match any page of the panel.

metrics.title: Statistics
metrics.empty: No data over this range yet.
metrics.dockerDegraded: Container metrics are lagging (recent readings failed).
metrics.upsUnavailable: UPS measurement disabled or server unreachable.

confirm.startMessage: The Factorio container will start and load the map.
confirm.stopMessage: The map is saved first, then the server is stopped. Players will be disconnected.
confirm.restartMessage: The map is saved first, then the server restarts. Players will be disconnected.

step.waiting_rcon: Waiting for the map to load
step.rolling_back: Rolling back to the previous state

saves.title: Saves
saves.liveEmpty: No save yet: the server has not created its map.
saves.modsCount: {count, plural, =0 {no mod} one {# mod} other {# mods}}

confirm.restoreMessage: The server is saved and stopped, the current state is archived, then {id} becomes the save and the server restarts. Players will be disconnected.
confirm.restoreUnknown: This save was imported from a computer: its Factorio version and mods are unknown. If they differ from the server's, the map may fail to load, or be migrated for good.

schedule.title: Scheduled backups
schedule.triggerSaveHint: Freezes the game while the save is written. Off: the newest autosave is archived.

import.title: Import a save
import.hint: A .zip save from your computer, up to {max}. It becomes an archive: restore it to play it.
import.tooLarge: This file is larger than the limit ({max}).
import.done: Sent. The archive is listed once the server has verified it.

mods.title: Mods
mods.versionUnknown: The game version is not known yet: start the server once so mods can be matched to it.
mods.installedEmpty: No mod list yet: the server has not started.
mods.updatesUnavailable: The mod portal could not be reached: available updates are not shown.

search.title: Find a mod
search.noCredentials: Searching and installing need a factorio.com account. Write your username and token to secrets/factorio-portal, next to docker-compose.yml (the token is on your factorio.com profile), then recreate the data agent:

basket.title: Pending changes
basket.empty: Nothing pending: add changes from the lists above.

conflict.missing: a required mod would be missing
conflict.version: a required mod has the wrong version
conflict.unpacked: installed as a folder, managed by hand
conflict.base: the base game cannot be disabled

confirm.applyMessage: The mods are downloaded and checked first, with the server still running. Then the map is saved and archived, the server stops, the mods are swapped in and the server restarts. Players will be disconnected.

serverSettings.title: Server settings
serverSettings.hint: server-settings.json. Factorio reads it when it starts: save for the next start, or save and restart to apply it now. Keys the panel does not know are kept as they are.
serverSettings.saved: Saved. Factorio applies it at its next start.

confirm.restartTitle: Restart the server with these settings?
confirm.restartMessage: The settings are written, the map is saved, then the server restarts. Players will be disconnected. If it does not come back, the previous settings are put back.

worlds.title: Worlds
worlds.versionMismatch: The world agent generates with Factorio {agent}, the server runs {server}: a world may differ from its preview, or need migrating. Set the same FACTORIO_IMAGE for both and rebuild the world agent.
worlds.creator: Create a world
worlds.creatorHint: seed, resources, terrain, enemies, rules — with a preview
worlds.catalogLoading: Reading the map generator from the game (a few seconds the first time)…
worlds.libraryEmpty: No world yet. Create one above: the server keeps running meanwhile.

confirm.activateMessage: The server is saved and stopped, the current map is archived, then “{name}” becomes the save and the server restarts. Players will be disconnected.
confirm.activateDetails: Nothing is lost: the current map stays in the Saves tab (“before restore”), and this world stays in the library. If the server does not come back, the previous map is restored automatically.
confirm.deleteMessage: “{name}” will be deleted from the library for good. A map already in play is not affected.

worlds.seedInvalid: The seed must be a whole number from 0 to 4294967295.
worlds.none: Nothing to set on this planet.
worlds.resourcesHint: Frequency: how many deposits. Size: how large each one is (0 % removes it). Richness: how much each tile holds.
worlds.rulesHint: Rules change how the world plays once created, not its terrain: the preview does not show them.

mapGen.sizeHint: A preset or the fields below start from the game's defaults; a dot marks what you changed.

advanced.hint: The form's changes as JSON, with Factorio's own names (map-gen-settings.json under mapGen, map-settings.json under mapSettings). Only the members the form knows are accepted.
advanced.invalid: Not valid JSON, or a member other than mapGen and mapSettings.

exchange.hint: Paste a string from the game's “Map exchange string” dialog to recreate that map exactly. It replaces the form; the seed field, left empty, keeps the string's own.
exchange.active: The exchange string is used: the form is ignored.

worlds.name: Name
worlds.createHint: Generated beside the server, which keeps running.
worlds.created: World “{name}” created (seed {seed}). Find it in the library below.
worlds.compareHint: Click a map to keep its seed.
worlds.previewEmpty: Choose settings, then Preview: the game draws the terrain without creating anything.
worlds.previewHint: Starting area at the centre. Previews never change the server's map.

errors.checksum_mismatch: This archive changed since it was made; it will not be restored.
errors.restore_incompatible: This archive comes from a different game: {gaps}.
errors.restore_rolled_back: The restore failed ({reason}); the previous state was put back.
errors.restore_rollback_failed: The restore failed ({reason}) and the previous state could not be put back: check the saves folder and the latest “before restore” archive.
errors.mods_disabled: Mods are disabled on this panel.
errors.mods_conflict: These changes have conflicts: preview them to see which.
errors.plan_changed: Something changed since the preview (a new release on the portal?): preview again.
errors.tx_not_found: This mod change is no longer available.

errors.invalid_mod_archive: A downloaded mod is not a valid archive of the expected release.
errors.mod_not_found: This mod is not on the mod portal.
errors.portal_credentials_missing: No mod portal credentials are configured (secrets/factorio-portal).
errors.portal_rejected: The mod portal refused the credentials: check secrets/factorio-portal.
errors.portal_unreachable: The mod portal could not be reached.
errors.download_too_large: A mod is larger than allowed (MODS_MAX_DOWNLOAD_MB).
errors.download_checksum: A downloaded mod does not match the portal's checksum.
errors.factorio_version_unknown: The game version is not known yet: start the server once.
errors.mods_rolled_back: The mod change failed ({reason}); the previous mods were put back.
errors.mods_rollback_failed: The mod change failed ({reason}) and the previous mods could not be put back: check the mods folder and the latest “before mod change” archive.
errors.upload_not_found: This upload no longer exists: start it again.
errors.upload_offset: The upload is out of step with the server; it resumes where the server stands.
errors.upload_too_large: This save is larger than allowed (SAVES_MAX_UPLOAD_MB).
errors.upload_incomplete: The upload is not complete yet.
errors.chunk_too_large: A piece of the upload is larger than allowed.
errors.server_settings_unavailable: The data agent does not mount Factorio's config folder (./data/config): add it to docker-compose.yml.
errors.server_settings_missing: The server has not created server-settings.json yet: start it once.
errors.server_settings_unreadable: server-settings.json is not valid JSON; fix it by hand first.
errors.invalid_setting: A setting has an invalid value.
errors.settings_changed: server-settings.json changed since it was loaded: refresh, then try again.
errors.settings_tx_not_found: The previous settings could not be found.
errors.public_needs_credentials: A public game needs a factorio.com username and a token or password.
errors.settings_rolled_back: The server did not restart with these settings ({reason}); the previous ones were put back.
errors.settings_rollback_failed: The server did not restart ({reason}), and putting the previous settings back failed too: check the server.

errors.world_timeout: The world agent did not respond in time.
errors.world_rejected: The world agent refused the panel's token.
errors.world_busy: The game is already generating a preview or a world. Try again in a moment.
errors.world_rate_limited: Too many previews. Try again in a minute.
errors.world_protocol: Unexpected response from the world agent.
errors.world_io: The world agent could not read or write its files.
errors.worlds_unavailable: The data agent cannot see the worlds folder: mount ./worlds into it.
errors.factorio_timeout: Factorio did not finish in time.
